chunk_text: If the 7th lord is in his own sign or in exaltation, one will obtain full happiness through his wife (and marriage).
Should the 7th lord be in the 6th, 8th or the 12th, the wife will be sickly. This, however, does not apply to own house or exaltation placements.
If Venus is in the 7th, the native will be exceedingly libidinous.
Venus being debilitated or combust in any house will cause loss of wife.
Should the 7th lord be endowed with strength and be conjunct or be aspected by a benefic, the native will be wealthy, happy and fortunate.

chunk_text: The native will befriend barren females for sexual union if the Sun is in the 7th.
The Moon in the 7th will cause association with such females as corresponding to the sign becoming the 7th.
Mars placed in the 7th will denote association with marriageable girls (or those with menses) or with barren females.
Mercury in the 7th indicates association with harlots, mean females and females belonging to the trader's community.
Wife of a Brahmin or a pregnant female will be in the native's association if Jupiter is in the 7th.
Base females and females having attained their courses are denoted by Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu in the 7th.
Mars related to the 7th house denotes a spouse with attractive breasts.
Saturn related to the 7th house indicates a sick and weak spouse.
Jupiter related to the 7th house will bring a spouse with hard and prominent breasts.
Venus related to the 7th house will bring a spouse with beautiful and excellent breasts.
Malefics in the 12th and 7th while a decreasing Moon is in the 5th denote that the native will be controlled by his wife and she will be inimical to the family.
If the 7th house is occupied or owned by Saturn or Mars, the native's spouse will be a harlot or be attached to other men illegally.
Should Venus be in a Navamsa of Mars, or in a Rasi of Mars, or be aspected by or conjunct Mars, the native will have unusual sexual habits with females.
If Venus is similarly related to Saturn (in Saturn's Rasi or Navamsa, or aspected by or conjunct Saturn), the native will have unusual sexual habits with males.
The native will beget a virtuous spouse who will expand his dynasty by sons and grandsons if the 7th lord is exalted, while the 7th house is occupied by a strong ascendant lord and a benefic.
If the 7th house or its lord is conjunct a malefic, the native's wife will incur evils, especially if the 7th house or its lord is bereft of strength.
